rules.question: overview
rules.questionText: What was this team working on?

summary.overview: Over the last 5 days, engineering sent 71 prompts to AI tools, mostly for coding (59%), data analysis (20%). 3 were flagged as sensitive.
problems: 4 prompts mention errors, bugs or something not working.
risks: 3 critical flag(s): credentials or keys pasted into prompts.
Most common reason: API key pattern (2).
Most common reason: password or login (1).
suggestions: Remind the team to keep keys and passwords out of AI prompts; rotate any that were pasted.
Most use is coding: an approved coding assistant setup and secret scanning before prompts would help.
